purpose: Own playable character movement, health, aiming, and host the infection runtime.
state_owner: Mutation skill combat effects and temporary buffs
Owned weapon slots and emergency key possession
Uncontrolled mutation movement and aim phase
Player weapon presentation stance and gameplay activity timers
Heal feedback effects (pickup burst, sparkles, floating HP numbers)

mission_wiring_v1.configure_weapon_drop: configure_weapon_drop(command: Callable) -> void; command(index, world_position) -> bool

blast_feedback_v1.blast_stun_started: signal blast_stun_started(duration: float, intensity: float); actual remaining duration and intensity after apply_blast_stun
blast_feedback_v1.blast_stun_ended: signal blast_stun_ended(); natural expiry, pause, game over or exit

blood_events_v1.projectile_blood: signal projectile_blood(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3, weapon: String, excluded: Array[RID], source_id: int)
blood_events_v1.wounded_moved: signal wounded_moved(previous: Vector3, current: Vector3, excluded: Array[RID])
blood_events_v1.blood_death: signal blood_death(position: Vector3, excluded: Array[RID], death_id: int)
blood_events_v1.take_projectile_damage: take_projectile_damage(amount: float, point: Vector3, direction: Vector3, weapon: String) -> void

character_push_v1.push_strength: push_strength: float = 1.0; passed to push_from_character with the intended pre-slide velocity

heal_feedback_v1.heal: heal(amount: float, source: StringName = &"") -> float; restored health after caps and skill bonuses; medkit pickups pass &"medkit"
heal_feedback_v1.healed: signal healed(amount: float, source: StringName); emitted only when health actually increased
